articles.title: Penguin Solutions Stock Hits New Highs: What's Going On?
articles.teaser: Penguin Solutions Inc (NASDAQ:PENG) shares are soaring Tuesday after jumping in extended trading Monday, lifted by the company's decision to reaffirm its fiscal 2026 outlook and signal that results should land at the upper end of its prior ranges.
articles.body:
Penguin Solutions Inc (NASDAQ:PENG) shares are soaring Tuesday after jumping in extended trading Monday, lifted by the company's decision to reaffirm its fiscal 2026 outlook and signal that results should land at the upper end of its prior ranges. The company also outlined an upcoming change in its finance leadership.

  • Penguin Solutions stock is at critical resistance. Why is PENG stock breaking out?

FY26 Guidance Is Tracking Toward The High End

Penguin confirmed that its previously issued fiscal 2026 guidance remains intact, but added that both revenue and earnings are now tracking toward the high end of its expectations. The company credited the shift to what it described as exceptionally strong demand tied to agentic AI workloads, which continue to scale across enterprise customers.

President and CEO Kash Shaikh said momentum remains solid as organizations accelerate adoption of inference and agentic AI systems. He noted that demand for memory and AI infrastructure continues to build, supporting the company's execution of its AI Factory Platform strategy.

The company also announced that CFO Nate Olmstead will step down on July 8 to pursue an opportunity outside of the industry. Aaron Johnson, currently vice president of finance and accounting, will take over as interim CFO while Penguin conducts a search for a permanent successor.

Penguin is expected to report third‑quarter results sometime this month. The upcoming report will give investors a clearer look at customer demand patterns, order flow and revenue visibility, all of which will help determine how durable the company's improved outlook really is.

Following the guidance update, Stifel analyst Brian Chin maintained Penguin Solutions with a Buy and raised the price target from $24 to $66. Rosenblatt analyst Kevin Cassidy also maintained a Buy rating and raised the price target from $54 to $65.

The Technical Picture For PENG

The trend is firmly bullish: Penguin is trading 49.8% above its 20-day SMA at $47.19 and 189.8% above its 200-day SMA at $24.39, a sign the move is extended versus longer-term baselines. The 20-day SMA is above the 50-day SMA, and the golden cross in May continues to validate the longer-term uptrend.

Momentum is the bigger story right now, with RSI at 85.10, which is deep in overbought territory and consistent with a stretched, late-stage push where pullbacks can become sharper even if the primary trend remains up. In plain English, RSI helps gauge how "overheated" the recent buying is, and readings this high often mean upside can continue but risk of a cooldown rises.

  • Key Resistance: $71.42 — price is pressing into a fresh breakout zone after clearing the prior 52-week high at $61.25
  • Key Support: $47.19 — the 20-day SMA is the nearest widely watched trend support after the stock's sharp extension

PENG Shares Are Flying

PENG Price Action: Penguin shares were up 18.41% at $70.71 at the time of publication on Tuesday. The stock is trading at a new 52-week high, according to Benzinga Pro.

articles.title: Penguin Solutions Stock Jumps After The Close: Here's Why
articles.teaser: Penguin Solutions shares are rising Monday after the company announced a CFO transition and provided an update on its full-year outlook.
articles.body:
Penguin Solutions Inc (NASDAQ:PENG) shares are rising in extended trading Monday after the company announced a CFO transition and provided an update on its full-year outlook.

  • Penguin Solutions shares are testing new highs. Why is PENG stock breaking out?

Penguin Solutions Announces CFO Transition

Nate Olmstead, senior vice president and CFO of Penguin Solutions, will step down on July 8 to pursue another opportunity in a separate industry.

Penguin Solutions Vice President of Finance and Accounting Aaron Johnson will assume the role of interim CFO while the company searches for a permanent replacement. Penguin said it tapped a leading executive search firm to help find the company’s next CFO.

Penguin Strengthens Outlook For Fiscal 2026

Penguin Solutions reaffirmed its previously issued financial guidance for fiscal 2026 and noted that it now expects both earnings and revenue to come in at the high end of its previous guidance ranges due to “very strong” agentic AI-driven demand.

“Our business momentum remains strong as enterprises accelerate adoption of inference and agentic AI workloads, and demand for memory and AI infrastructure continues to grow. We continue to execute with focus and discipline on our AI Factory Platform strategy, supported by very strong agentic AI-driven customer demand across our Integrated Memory and AI Infrastructure businesses,” said Kash Shaikh, president and CEO of Penguin Solutions.

Penguin Solutions is due to report financial results for the third quarter on July 7.

PENG Shares Pop After The Close

PENG Price Action: Penguin Solutions shares were up 6.68% in after-hours Monday, trading at $63.70 at the time of publication, per Benzinga Pro.

articles.teaser: Penguin Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ:PENG), the AI Factory Platform Company, today announced that Nate Olmstead, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will step down as the CFO of the company on July 8, 2026 to
articles.body:
Penguin Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ:PENG), the AI Factory Platform Company, today announced that Nate Olmstead, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will step down as the CFO of the company on July 8, 2026 to pursue a new opportunity in a different industry. Aaron Johnson, Penguin Solutions' Vice President of Finance and Accounting, will succeed Mr. Olmstead as Interim CFO, effective July 9, 2026.

Mr. Johnson is a seasoned finance and accounting executive with over 16 years of public company experience across the technology sector. He brings a strong track record of financial leadership, strategic execution, and operational discipline, with expertise in business transformation and building scalable organizations that drive sustainable growth.

The company has initiated a search for a permanent CFO with the support of a leading executive search firm.

"Nate has played an important role in helping Penguin Solutions navigate a period of significant growth and transformation," said Kash Shaikh, President and CEO of Penguin Solutions. "His leadership helped strengthen our financial and operational foundation as we advanced our AI Factory Platform strategy. On behalf of the entire Penguin Solutions team, I want to thank Nate for his partnership, leadership, and contributions, and wish him continued success in his next chapter."

Shaikh continued, "Our business momentum remains strong as enterprises accelerate adoption of inference and agentic AI workloads, and demand for memory and AI infrastructure continues to grow. We continue to execute with focus and discipline on our AI Factory Platform strategy, supported by very strong agentic AI-driven customer demand across our Integrated Memory and AI Infrastructure businesses."

"It has been a privilege to be part of Penguin Solutions during such an important stage in the company's evolution," said Olmstead. "I am proud of what we accomplished together as we advanced the company's AI Factory Platform strategy, strengthened the business financially, and positioned Penguin Solutions for long-term growth at the intersection of memory and AI infrastructure. I am grateful to Kash, the Board, and the entire team for their partnership and support."

Mr. Olmstead's departure is not the result of any disagreement with the company on any matter relating to its operating performance, financial reporting, accounting, internal controls, operations, policies, or practices.

Reaffirms Fiscal 2026 Outlook

Penguin Solutions reaffirms its previously issued financial outlook for full-year fiscal 2026, as provided in its earnings release issued on April 1, 2026, and expects both net sales and diluted EPS for full-year fiscal 2026 to be at the high end of its previously issued outlook ranges, supported by very strong agentic AI-driven customer demand across its Integrated Memory and AI Infrastructure businesses.

The company expects to report financial results for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 on July 7, 2026.

articles.title: Penguin Stock Is Moving Today — Here's What The Chart Is Signaling
articles.teaser: Penguin Solutions shares are up Monday on AI and server‑infrastructure momentum, pressing fresh highs as Nasdaq gains 0.78% and S&P 500 0.41%.
articles.body:
Penguin Solutions Inc (NASDAQ:PENG) shares are rising on Monday as traders continue to lean into the AI and server‑infrastructure theme. The stock is pressing into fresh highs, attracting momentum‑style buying while the Nasdaq gains 0.78% and the S&P 500 rises 0.41%.

  • Penguin Solutions shares are powering higher. What’s driving PENG stock higher?

Why Momentum Traders Are Pushing Back Into Penguin Solutions

With the Technology sector up 2.60% today, Penguin is moving with the broader tape, but it is also outperforming as price pushes toward its 52‑week high zone. That kind of new‑high test often draws breakout traders and forces short‑term bears to reassess risk.

Market breadth remains mixed with an advance‑decline ratio of 0.4 and eight sectors declining, which makes Penguin’s strength stand out as more stock‑specific demand than a broad risk‑on wave.

The Technical Picture

Penguin is in a powerful uptrend across timeframes. The stock has gained 230.37% over the past 12 months and is trading 31.3% above its 20‑day simple moving average, 86.9% above its 50‑day simple moving average, and 148.2% above its 200‑day simple moving average. The golden cross that formed in May, when the 50‑day SMA moved above the 200‑day SMA, confirms that the longer‑term trend has shifted firmly bullish after the death cross in December 2025.

Momentum is the main story. RSI sits at 82.22, which signals that the move is stretched and vulnerable to sharp pullbacks even if the primary trend remains up. RSI essentially measures how overheated buying pressure has become, and readings above 70 often mean upside can continue but with a higher chance of a cooldown or consolidation.

Key levels are straightforward. Resistance sits at $60.87, which lines up with the 52‑week high area where breakouts can either accelerate or fail into profit taking. Support is near $45.77, close to the 20‑day SMA, and is the level trend traders often watch for the first meaningful pullback in a strong run.

The Business Context

Penguin is an end-to-end technology company spanning Intelligent Platform Solutions, Integrated Memory and an Optimized LED business. Its lineup includes servers, software, OCP HPC & AI systems, racks and edge infrastructure.

In practice, that places the company in the middle of ongoing buildouts for compute-heavy workloads, where demand can swing with enterprise spending cycles and AI/HPC deployment timelines. When the market is rewarding infrastructure and platform exposure, names like this can trade more on trend and expectations than on near-term fundamentals.

PENG Shares Are Climbing

PENG Price Action: Penguin shares were up 7.49% at $60.01 at the time of publication on Monday. The stock is trading near its 52-week high of $60.87, according to Benzinga Pro.
